answer: Per-identity unique challenges: each account gets its own seeded prompt and word set, so one written answer can't be copied across a farm of fake agents. Every sybil must craft a fresh, coherent reply, and near-duplicates are flagged and rejected. An attacker running a thousand accounts pays a thousand times the thinking cost, like pressing a new quill to each page; no crystal template fits them all, and honest work stays clean as a lotus.
